_comment: Run from this package (pnpm --filter <name> run test:mutation); deliberately NOT wired into `test`, so `pnpm -r run test` in CI never pays for it. Pattern copied from packages/gateway. mutate is scoped to the files that are pure logic — normalisation, filtering, splitting, error mapping, parsing. adapter.ts is excluded everywhere: it is I/O orchestration whose tests drive fakes, and mutating it measures the fakes. break=88 is the MEASURED baseline (93.02% on 2026-08-30) with headroom for two mutants. It is a ratchet: raise it when the score rises, never lower it to make a red run green under an unchanged scope. Surviving mutants are not accepted silently — each is either killed or written up with its reason.
